mechanism.base: Wood beside wood makes a forest, the old texts say, and like gathers with like. A trunk that stands alone grows wide, and a trunk among others grows tall, because every tree reaches for the same light and drinks from the same ground. The one beside it is shelter and competition. Nothing is handed out in a forest. Height is taken, a season's growth at a time, by whoever reaches first.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Wood, the trunk is thin for the height it carries, and every reach is paid out of the next season's growth. Rest and eat before you reach again.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Wood, the trunk thickens past any use for it, and growth that nothing shaped bends for no one. Give one thing a hard deadline and finish it.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it growth, a reach fed by what goes in. Running thin, the reserve under your reach is small and every push draws on all of it. You often run out before the thing is done.
function.definition_friction: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it a reach that keeps going once started. Running over, your push outgrows every plan and partner, because your own way is the one you trust. You press on and lose the people beside you.
function.definition_balanced: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it growth, a reach fed by what goes in. In balance, what goes in keeps pace with the reach. You hold your own ground and still have space for a peer beside you.
function.advise_catalyst: Holding yourself up takes more than you are taking in. Start one weekly session that builds your strength, like swimming or climbing. Grow one plant from seed and give it water each morning. Hand one errand to someone else this month and leave it with them.
function.advise_friction: Seek Metal, the Order energy. Metal is the line that holds, a rule you did not write and a date you cannot move. Let it shape what Wood keeps growing. Nothing outside you sets your limits. Close one open project this week and say it is done. Let someone else set the end point for one plan.

candidates.cta_verdict: You hold yourself up by growing, so you feel strongest while something is being built and restless once it is finished.

catalyst.clause: The trunk is thin for the height it carries.
catalyst.remedy: Rest and eat before you reach again.

friction.clause: The trunk thickens past any use for it.
friction.remedy: Give one thing a hard deadline and finish it.

unrooted.clause: Wood with no root under it, a trunk on borrowed ground, upright only while the weather holds.
unrooted.remedy: Borrow roots. Keep one routine and one early bedtime.

excess.clause: So much Wood that nothing bends it, and only a fire would ever soften the stubborn grain.
excess.remedy: Set it alight. Make one thing and give it away.

thin.clause: Only a little Wood shows, a thin trunk the ground holds easily.
thin.remedy: Keep it small and spend what it grows.

catalyst.clause: The vine doubts itself: direction borrowed, growth waiting for permission.

friction.clause: The vine covers the wall: growth so dense no other light gets in, growth for growth’s own sake.
friction.remedy: Thin the tendrils and let the wall breathe.

mechanism_yin.base: Things gather by kind, the Book of Changes says, and so wood stands with wood: one hedge sharing one root system, every vine raising the cover that shelters the next shoot. There is no reaction here, only more of the same green force. A single vine is weather's toy. A wall of them makes its own shade.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the vine doubts itself: direction borrowed, growth waiting for permission. Your chart asks you to feed the self. Start something and let it grow visibly yours.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the vine covers the wall: growth so dense no other light gets in, growth for growth's own sake. Thin the tendrils and let the wall breathe.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Core is your endurance function: the seat where strength renews itself. With Wood doubled here, your vitality works like a living tree: it recovers by growing, and it outlasts by renewal, fresh shoots after every cutback. Your reserves are seasonal rather than constant, so honor the winters as part of the engine. A tree that never sheds snaps in the first real storm.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Wood, and here Wood stands with Wood: growth alongside growth, one forest sharing a root system. This is a reinforcement rather than a reaction, the part of your chart that is simply more of you. That is why Wood is your Body: your direction, your reaching, your green stubborn aliveness made physical. The other energies act on you. This one is you.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: You judge by trajectory: where a thing leads in ten years outweighs its snapshot today.
backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: You decide by starting: the sapling planted teaches you whether the plan was right.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Wood is your Body, and running thin, it is the growth reserve your whole system draws on: appetite, stamina, the will to start things. When it dips you feel it as flatness before you feel it as fatigue.

Lively by design, lately muted. Meals get skipped without hunger noticing, weekends pass without anything begun, and the person who used to start things watches other people start them instead. Nothing is wrong exactly. There is just less of you available than there used to be.

Vitality is grown, never summoned. Get daylight before noon, move every day even briefly, keep green things and green places near you. Protect one truly free evening a week. Start one small thing and let finishing it feed the next.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Wood is your Body, and running over, it is more growing force than your life gives outlets: restlessness, overcommitment, energy that starts five things just to spend itself.

Expansive, eager, impossible to keep still. Every idea becomes a signup, every free hour becomes a plan, and the body hums at bedtime like something still mid-sprint. Unspent growth does not wait politely. It turns on its owner as agitation.

Force without direction becomes pressure on the vessel. Spend it hard and on purpose: train until tired, walk far, build with your hands. Cap active projects at two. When restlessness spikes, exercise before you commit to anything new.
